blocks.text: open this day for the merit of those who wait for Him to reign. She with the princely tread, when the sound of (Esau's) tears implored, said: 'the kingdom is mine, who else can then reign?' The lowly and humble who seek for merit on the day of judgment, are bowed by the yoke of the kingdom until the Rock shall reign. There is wandering here and there on a way of five hundred years until in glory is He crowned and in His might shall He reign. As to Bel set on a throne, over what does he reign? Through whom was he crowned that he has hastened to reign? Before any king ruled, the Everlasting was king; and when all kings cease, He alone will reign. What might has Molech before the might of the King's judgment? When a whirlwind sweeps by him, he ceases to reign. The Pure One arranges justice and holds fast to His way, when He treads down the proud, He wears vengeance

blocks.text: to fight fought and perished, for the Lord had sworn by the throne of the kingdom. Amalek earned shame in every generation since he had not learned who fought at the sea and was clothed in the kingdom. The slave, who lived in the south, presumed against his master, whereupon the earth trembled when the slave took the kingdom. The seed of the blessed (Israel) destroyed the accursed since they raised their voice against Him who is glorious in kingdom. Heshbon and Bashan stirred up war for they would not grant passage to the hosts of the kingdom. Their army was annihilated, their land was divided and their seed was deprived of a kingdom. The Canaanites were foolish for they had been strangers on the soil of the sons of Shem, the seed of the kingdom. The son of Nun slew them until he cleared the land before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the kingdom. The man of Harosheth was hard in oppression, there helped him without pay those far from the kingdom. The Lord fought against them with a Host without payment, may the rest perish likewise and to God be the kingdom. Like the cedar on Lebanon did Assyria grow great and blasphemed: 'In my might I will bring down the kingdom'. When the ray of fire destroyed them in the night of vigil, then all could perceive

blocks.text: and reigns. When He casts down the garland of the proud, He will give power to His appointed king, when He crowns the pure over all will He reign. He renews the realm according to faith and law that the royal offspring may in equity reign. He soothes in healing after the long time of trouble, He will bandage the wound at the time when He will reign. The oppression of the kingdoms, worshippers of images, they have defiled the most precious sights in their pride to reign. To the purity of merits, the roar of the sound of weeping of those cast into the raging floods the Lord will turn, and over them will He reign. Upon Him the royal princes (Israel) lay their burden, on this day do they wait for Him that on it He will come to reign. They pass while walking before Him like angels, paying homage in unison: 'The Lord will reign'. When He crushes the Kittim, when He smites the islands, the throne of His kingdom will be established and

blocks.text: that to God was the kingdom. Bel sank into ruin when he planned to rise to heaven, human reason left him and he descended from the kingdom. When restored to his place, he acknowledged God's power, to Him who raises and lowers, he delivered the kingdom. Like sheep to the slaughter was it (Israel) to be driven, then was God's work accomplished by the youngest tribe (Benjamin from whom Esther was descended) through the power of the kingdom. You who were sold without a price (Israel) will be redeemed without silver, prepare the way for Him who turns like water the heart of the kingdom. The doves (Israel) were sold to the Greeks and they banished them from the frontier of the kingdom. Covenant and law were broken, they caused the people to rebel against God, then powerless were they crushed by the priests of the kingdom. The hairy one flattered his father with his venison and through the sound of weeping inherited sword and kingdom. Exalted will be the smooth one, becoming master to his brothers and once again will return to Yeshurun the kingdom.
